purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for the single Stödassistenten learning system. Scores are ordinal discovery priorities, not measured search volumes or eligibility evidence. Dental 67+ rules become truth-bearing only after current primary-source verification; commercial FAQ pages are discovery signals only.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. These scores guide eval, retrieval and question-order work only.

natural_language_queries: jag fyller 67 i år betyder tiotandvård att hela tandläkarbesöket kostar tio procent
ingår undersökning och röntgen i tiotandvård
betalar jag tio procent av tandläkarens pris eller av referenspriset
gäller nya tandvårdsstödet alla tänder och alla behandlingar efter 67

demand_signal.basis: Dental cost worry is already a permanent older-person scenario and the 2026 reform creates a new age-specific decision point. Current public FAQ-style pages repeatedly explain the same 67+, 10-percent and included/excluded-measure questions; this is qualitative prioritization, not measured search volume.

friction_signal.basis: The shorthand 'tiotandvård' can be misread as ten percent of the whole invoice. Safe guidance must separate reference price from clinic price, covered treatment measures from examinations/X-rays/preventive care, and the strengthened protection from the ordinary high-cost protection that remains.

miss_consequence.basis: Overgeneralizing the rule can create a materially wrong cost expectation before treatment, while under-explaining it can make an older user delay necessary dental care or fail to request an itemized estimate.

source_fragmentation.basis: The user-facing overview is on Försäkringskassan while detailed current measure and reference-price rules are maintained by TLV, so a specific treatment-cost answer cannot safely rely on one generic page alone.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as referenspris, särskild tandvårdsersättning, ersättningsberättigande åtgärd and tandposition are technical; the popular name 'tiotandvård' encourages an overly simple interpretation.

steps_to_action.basis: A useful next step can be short: establish whether the person reaches the 67+ rule in 2026, identify the planned measures, and obtain an itemized clinic price/reference-price breakdown before estimating cost.

recurrence_signal.basis: The same ambiguity recurs whenever a 67+ patient combines an examination or X-ray with treatment, or hears '10 percent' without knowing which measures and price base it refers to. This is a qualitative recurrence signal.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The existing dental quick-help path correctly points to state dental support and price estimates, but it is generic and does not permanently guard the 2026 67+ distinction between strengthened coverage, excluded measures and reference-price semantics.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Add the 67+ strengthened dental protection as a permanent synthetic regression in the existing scenario laboratory, require age/year + planned measure + reference-price disambiguation before cost claims, and keep the public generic dental path visibly marked as a coverage gap until a source-grounded age-aware route is added.
signals.truth_rule: Verify current age scope, covered measures and reference prices against Försäkringskassan and TLV before stating coverage or cost; do not treat commercial FAQ wording, the label 'tiotandvård', or an age label alone as proof that every measure is covered.
